name: Headhunter
text: Once per game: swap a rival’s member with a shop member of equal or greater cost.

name: Host
text: On Recruit: +1 red per 2 members. Round Start: +1 red per 2 members.

name: Loyalists
text: Your other members can’t be swapped.

name: Mentor & Protégé
text: On Recruit: recruit the cheapest member in the shop.

name: Mob
text: Game end: +1 follower per red member.

name: Movement Penalty
text: When you move a rival’s member out of their cult, they lose 1 follower.

name: Panel
text: On Recruit: Promote or Demote another member.

name: Patriarch
text: Game end: +1 follower per 2 members.

name: Proselytizer
text: Whenever you recruit, +1 follower.

name: Recruit Bonus
text: Whenever one of your members’ "On Recruit" happens, +1 of its color.

name: Twins
text: Worth 2 followers.

name: Volunteer
text: Worth 1 follower.

name: Accomplice
text: On Recruit: steal 3 resources.

name: Crew
text: Worth 2 followers.

name: Cutpurse
text: On Recruit: steal 1 resource from the rival with the most resources. Round Start: steal 1 resource from the rival with the most resources.

name: Desperado
text: While you have the fewest followers (ties count), double what you steal from spaces, before other bonuses.

name: Double Agent
text: On Recruit: swap it for a rival’s member you choose.

name: Extortionist
text: On Recruit: steal 2 resources from the rival with the most resources. Round Start: steal 2 resources from the rival with the most resources.

name: Fixer
text: Once per game: spend magenta equal to a rival’s member’s cost to steal it.

name: Grifter
text: On Recruit: steal 1 resource per 2 members you have.

name: Kingpin
text: Game end: +1 follower per magenta member you have.

name: Robin Hood
text: Whenever you steal from the player with the most followers, +1 follower.

name: Shoplifter
text: Whenever you recruit, steal 1 resource.

name: Snitch
text: Whenever a rival steals from you, they lose 1 follower.

name: Sticky Fingers
text: Your steals take 1 more resource.

name: Bodyguard
text: Rivals can’t steal from you.
